# Hi, I'm Kyle.

<img src="{{ '/assets/img/me.jpg' | relative_url }}" alt="Kyle Stellmann" style="width: 100%; max-width: 450px; height: auto; margin-bottom: 20px; border-radius: 4px;">

I’m a Junior studying Mechanical Engineering at **Rowan University**, born and raised in Wantage, New Jersey. 



Ever since I can remember, I’ve been fascinated by taking things apart to see how they work and putting them back together better than I found them. To me, Engineering is more than just equations and calculations, it is about the feeling of building something tangible and seeing an idea function in the real world.

---

### What Drives Me

I like taking on challenges that push me out of my comfort zone. Whether I’m spending hours in the machine shop or troubleshooting code on a microcontroller, I thrive on the process of learning through doing.

---

### Life Beyond the Classroom

When I’m not in class, you’ll usually find me:

* **In the Garage:** I do all my own vehicle maintenance. Mostly because my car and truck seem to find new ways to break themselves. From suspension overhauls to bodywork, I love taking on practical mechanical challenges off the screen.

<img src="{{ '/assets/img/truck.jpg' | relative_url }}" alt="Working on my truck in the garage" style="display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 500px; height: auto; border-radius: 4px; margin: 15px auto;">

* **In the Gym:** I’m at the gym every morning right when doors open. Engineering requires long hours sitting at screens, so keeping a strong, healthy body is essential for keeping a sharp mind.
* **In the Community:** I volunteer with **Assistive Technologies**, designing and modifying everyday objects to make them accessible for individuals with mobility challenges.
* **On Campus:** I’m an active member of Rowan’s **Martinson Honors College** and **ASME** (American Society of Mechanical Engineers).
* **On the Job:** I work at Liscio’s Bakery to help pay my way through school. The fast paced environment keeps my time management sharp and reinforces the value of simple, hard work.

---
